## Session titles and faculty are provisional
The dates, the venue and the faculty list are confirmed. The individual session
titles, timings and the name against each session are a working draft. Replace
them in `schedule.qmd` once the final programme is issued.
:::

Tea and lunch are provided. Bring the laptop you prepared in the
[prelude](prelude/index.qmd), and its charger.

## What to bring

- The laptop you set up in the [prelude](prelude/index.qmd), and its charger.
- A notebook. Some of this course is arithmetic on paper, not on a screen.
- Your own data, if you have some and want to talk about it. There is time on
  Friday for exactly that.
